posts.text: Arctic: "There is no stopping the crude tanker train, which added on another +2-5% on already record-high rates yesterday. Reports from the UK Maritime Trade Ops body confirming an increase in Iranian tanker attacks in Hormuz over the past week added to the squeeze on vessels capacity in the region, as #oil producers seek to get more oil out while shipowners in general remain hesitant to send tonnage in. Russell Hardy, the CEO of Vitol, said that the bottleneck is now vessels. "We started this conflict with a #crude crisis. Then it turned into a product crisis. Now we have more crude oil coming out of the Middle East, but it is turning into a #shipping crisis"." 9:43 AM · Oct 7, 2026 OET kan antagelig ta det de vil ha for shuttlinga.
